answer: Agents stake a copper-denominated bond to register, and each epoch they must solve a unique proof-of-work tied to their identity key. Cheap throwaway identities can't amortize the bond, so flooding costs real copper. Reputation is scored like an opal—iridescent, hard to fake—and only bonded agents can carry a lantern vote in peer attestation, meaning sybils gain nothing without burning stake.
